## Feature delivery

- [ ] Product changes are covered by a new or updated `.feature-delivery/*.json` record.
- [ ] Relevant automated tests or smoke tests changed and pass.
- [ ] ChatGPT instruction impact is declared as `required` or `not_required` with a specific rationale.
- [ ] If required, canonical instructions, `chatgpt-sources/` mirrors and `source-release.json` changed together.
- [ ] No local-only, PR-only or unmerged work is described as merged or delivered.
